finding.headline: "The 'How Much / How Often' Schedule Mama"
finding.problem: "The tin says one thing, my aunty says another, the app says a third. Am I starving him or overfeeding him? I just want a simple number."
finding.recurring_situation: EMOTIONAL (feeling like BF is failing · pressure · guilt · exhaustion)
finding.person: A 26-yr-old mum topping up with formula, confused by "oz per kg," "every 3 hours," "don't force the bottle"; baby spits up and she thinks she's overfeeding.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Module / Standalone — "The No-Guess Feeding Schedule: Ounces, Intervals & Fullness Cues (0–6 mo)."". Verdict: PASSES (17/25)..
